forsaken:ArmorOfThorns.NAME: Armor of Thorns
forsaken:ArmorOfThorns.FLAVOR: It may be good for battle, but it also prevents hugs :(
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you gain Block, deal #b3 damage to all enemies.

forsaken:BlackenedSunEmblem.NAME: Blackened Sun Emblem
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you gain #yWeak, #yVulnerable, or #yPoison, also gain #b
#yVigor.

forsaken:FadingSunlight.NAME: Fading Sunlight
forsaken:FadingSunlight.FLAVOR: A passing gleam in the darkness.
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. Whenever you finish an Elite or Boss combat, lose #r5 max HP.

forsaken:Gavel.NAME: Gavel
forsaken:Gavel.FLAVOR: Figuratively renders judgement. Literally renders unconscious.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you play #b3 skills in a turn, gain #b
bonus damage.

forsaken:GuardianBells.NAME: Guardian Bells
forsaken:GuardianBells.FLAVOR: Fashioned into the form of a pair of gargoyles.
DESCRIPTIONS: It takes 1 more card played to trigger #yQuickdraw. Quickdraw activates twice.

forsaken:HumbleEgg.NAME: Humble Egg
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you add a #yCommon card into your deck, #yUpgrade it. When you first draw a common card each turn, draw an extra card.

forsaken:JudgementScales.NAME: Judgement Scales
DESCRIPTIONS: Each turn, gain #yStrength / #yDexterity based on played cards. NL (Gain #b1 #yStrength if you've played no attacks, and #b1 #yDexterity if you've played no skills.)

forsaken:Kindling.NAME: Kindling
forsaken:Kindling.FLAVOR: Brighter flames seem to fend off the encroaching dark.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you rest at a rest site, increase your Max HP by #b

forsaken:Lifeblossom.NAME: Lifeblossom
forsaken:Lifeblossom.FLAVOR: This rare flower grows only in a hidden garden in a legendary forest.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the beginning of each battle, gain #b
regen.

forsaken:PaleLantern.NAME: Pale Lantern
forsaken:PaleLantern.FLAVOR: Provides a comforting glow in the dark.
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain [E] at the start of your turn. Draw 1 less card each turn.

forsaken:PlagueMask.NAME: Plague Mask
forsaken:PlagueMask.FLAVOR: It was believed these masks could prevent disease, but they only seem to spread it.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you are inflicted with poison, apply it to a random enemy also.

forsaken:MarkOfTheForsaken.NAME: Mark of the Forsaken
forsaken:MarkOfTheForsaken.FLAVOR: Those who bear the mark can no longer seek absolution.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you begin your turn with #yWeak or #yVulnerable, all attacks in your hand deal 1 more damage this combat.

forsaken:ScalesOfTruth.NAME: Scales of Truth
forsaken:ScalesOfTruth.FLAVOR: It is said that if one's heart is light as a feather, the Truth will be understood.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #yJudgement #yScales. For every 3 #yunplayed skills, gain 1 dexterity. For every 3 #yunplayed attacks, gain 1 strength.

forsaken:ScaryMask.NAME: Scary Mask
forsaken:ScaryMask.FLAVOR: Created to terrify the Spire's weaker denizens.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first attack played each combat inflicts #b1 #yFear

forsaken:Sunblade.NAME: Sunblade
forsaken:Sunblade.FLAVOR: Forged for a single, perfect strike.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first attack you play each combat does #b
more damage for the rest of this combat.

forsaken:SunlightMedallion.NAME: Sunlight Medallion
forsaken:SunlightMedallion.FLAVOR: A simple token to commemorate Jolly Cooperation.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b3 #ySunlight

forsaken:TearstoneRing.NAME: Tearstone Ring
forsaken:TearstoneRing.FLAVOR: This rare gem can sense when its bearer is in danger.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you draw #b10 #yUnplayable cards, gain #b
#yVigor

forsaken:WornEffigy.NAME: Worn Effigy
forsaken:WornEffigy.FLAVOR: Worn smooth by hands that needed it.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you lose HP from #yPoison, draw 2 cards.
